chapter: Regional bands, politics and travel abroad
title: Texas and Oklahoma jazz: Alonzo Trent and Stuff Smith
summary: Wilson says the Trent band in Dallas, Stuff Smith, the Johnson brothers and Charlie Christian show the Southwest produced much jazz.

blocks.x: I don't think the West Coast had any important jazz in those days, did they?
But down in Texas that was speared by the Alonzo Trent Band in Dallas, big bands.
-- came out of the Trent band. Stuff Smith founded the Trent band.

Yeah, he played with Trent's band. Trent played the piano and Stuff stood in front of the band with a violin. That was based in Dallas. That's a lot of jazz town. You know, the Johnson Brothers came out of Dallas, Keg and Bud.
A lot of great jazz came from around there. Oklahoma, Charlie Christian was from Oklahoma City, Jimmy Rushing's from Oklahoma City, I think. I'm pretty sure.
